scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The proposed HNRNPLL-mediated exclusion of PTPRC variable exon 4 is an established and biologically defensible mechanism for reducing surface CD45RA. The main limitation is that HNRNPLL transcript abundance may not uniformly explain protein variation across heterogeneous neonatal lineages because cell identity and post-transcriptional factors can confound the predicted correlation.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response explicitly connects HNRNPLL induction and binding to PTPRC silencing elements with exon 4 exclusion and reduced surface CD45RA. Activation, lineage commitment, and the differences between T-cell and progenitor compartments remain broad contextual factors rather than resolved upstream components of the mechanism. No ceiling was applied because a clear and biologically reasonable multi-step focus-feature–target mechanism was provided.
